lines.trans: Let's suppose the governor has a pile of money.
But how will he hand them over to us?
And right here you will need my experience.
This pig dreams of becoming a major minister.
We should offer him a ministerial post for a bribe.
The governor will not believe that so easily.
I will arrange everything at the highest level.
But I need three percent of the money.
I can offer you only a suspended sentence.
And a modest state bonus for your help.
No, that's not how our business will work!
Arkady Borisovich agrees to these conditions!
Marina, this is purely a men's business conversation.
I am protecting your future from foolishness.
